messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — running a 12-team design-partner mini-cohort ("slate") next month. Need recruit + feedback loop + success criteria checklist. Anyone free to align on ops?
Sam (Eng): I'm in. What's target size and runtime?
Priya (PM): Target 8-12 partners, 6-week program, weekly checkins + async prompts. Goal = validate rollout gates for private deployment and Dedicated performance profiles.
Jules (Design): Suggest 2 persona buckets: 'platform integrators' (SaaS infra teams) and 'app builders' (product PMs). Each cohort -> 3 integrators + 5 app builders.
Avery (Solutions): We should require a short use-case card + staging dataset access. Screening q: 'Production traffic today?' with options.
Nina (Research): For feedback loops, propose: weekly 20-min call, 2 short surveys (week 2 & 5), open playbook doc + annotated prompt set. Use this template: 
```
Week1: integration + baseline eval
Week2: prompt/response regressions
Week3: latency/cost telemetry review
Week4: rollout canary simulation
Week5: quality guardrails & opt suggestions
Week6: wrap + success metrics
```
Sam (Eng): Telemetry we need: p50/p95 latency per route, tokens per request, cache hit rate, cost per 1k tokens. Can we expose per-partner dashboards?
Priya (PM): Yes — Redwood Console per-route dashboard will be provisioned. Ops: we need onboarding checklist + NDA.
Avery (Solutions): Proposed success criteria (pass if >=3 met): 1) integration <= 2 days, 2) <5% quality regression vs baseline, 3) production-sim latency SLO met for 95% of requests, 4) partner willing to open short case study.
Liam (Eng): For scope negotiation: agree to support model pinning + canary rollback. Anything else we must guarantee?
Jules (Design): Keep prompts versioned in repo and ask partners to label failure types. Small ask.
BetaOpsBot: Reminder: submit cohort invites by Fri EOD. Template link: https://go/redwood/dp-template
Priya (PM): Action items: Sam -> dashboard provisioning by Tue; Avery -> screening form + NDA draft; Nina -> survey + playbook template; Jules -> prompt versioning doc. I'll batch invites once NDA + screen ready.
Sam (Eng): Noted. Will spin up stub dashboards on dev cluster.
Avery (Solutions): I'll share screening short-url in channel by tomorrow.
Nina (Research): I'll draft survey questions and post for review.
Jules (Design): I'll add prompt tagging conventions.
Priya (PM): Thanks all :tada: — we'll loop in legal for NDAs. If anyone has partner recommendations drop them here or DM.
Liam (Eng): One more: test quantization variant with 8-bit; add to canary matrix.
Priya (PM): Good call — add to week4 canary matrix.
